placement: wrist watch or explicitly annotated phone hand/pocket placement
note: Source-isolated, label-free view of public ExtraSensory raw accelerometer captures. Storage uses one Parquet per participant and stream; an integer segment_id preserves every raw capture or clock-split part as an independent windowing boundary. Activity labels are never read or filtered. The label table is read only for the two deployment-valid phone placements (hand and pocket); the published split is read only for Android/iPhone unit normalization. Android m/s^2, iPhone g, and Pebble watch milli-g are normalized to g with gravity present, then each uninterrupted capture is resampled independently to 50 Hz. Raw archives are fetched once into and reused from data/datasets/extrasensory/downloads. Every emitted session carries only __unlabeled__ and is restricted to JEPA pretraining.
